name: @volunteer-portal/observability
description: Shared observability primitives (ADR-0013: Sentry + OpenTelemetry + structured logging): the structured-log envelope + redaction, the request/trace-id AsyncLocalStorage context, the Sentry-agnostic error-reporter adapter, and the outbox-lag threshold evaluator. Framework-agnostic on purpose — both apps/web (Next.js) and apps/worker (graphile-worker) depend on this package and each wires in their own concrete Sentry client / Prisma query.
